grid.expression: SELECT NUNOTA, NUMNOTA, DTNEG, DTENTSAI, STATUSNFE, CODTIPOPER, CODPARC, NOMEPARC, CODTIPPARC, UF_DEST AS UF_DEST, UF_ORIG AS UF_ORIG, CHAVENFE, IDENTINSCESTAD, --DESCRGRUPOPROD, SUM(VLRCTB) AS VLRTOT, MAX(CODCFO) AS CODCFO, MAX(CODTRIB) AS CODTRIB, SUM(BASEICMS) AS BASEICMS, MAX(ALIQICMS) AS ALIQICMS, SUM(VLRICMS) AS VLRICMS, MAX(CSTIPI) AS CSTIPI, SUM(BASEIPI) AS BASEIPI, MAX(ALIQIPI) AS ALIQIPI , SUM(VLRIPI) AS VLRIPI, SUM(BASE_PIS) AS BASE_PIS, SUM(VLR_PIS) AS VLR_PIS, SUM(BASE_COFINS) AS BASE_COFINS, SUM(VLR_COFINS) AS VLR_COFINS, SUM(BASE_ST) AS BASE_ST, SUM(VLR_ST) AS VLR_ST, SUM(VLR_FEM_ICMS_ST) AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_ST, SUM(VLR_FEM_ICMS_OP) AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_OP FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTENTSAI, CASE WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE IS NULL AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' THEN '-----' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' THEN 'Aprovada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'D' THEN 'Denegada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'E' THEN 'Aguardando Autorização' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'I' THEN 'Enviada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'M' THEN 'Não é NF-e' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'P' THEN 'Pendente de Retorno' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'R' THEN 'Aguardando Correção' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'S' THEN 'Enviada EPEC' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'T' THEN 'NF-e Terceiro' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'V' THEN 'Com erro de Validação' ELSE 'Não Enviada' END AS STATUSNFE, CAB.CODTIPOPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, PAR.CODTIPPARC, ITE.SEQUENCIA, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.QTDNEG, ITE.VLRUNIT, LIV.VLRCTB, ITE.CODCFO, ITE.CODTRIB, ITE.BASEICMS, ITE.ALIQICMS, ITE.VLRICMS, ITE.CSTIPI, ITE.BASEIPI, ITE.ALIQIPI , ITE.VLRIPI, LIV.UFDESTINO AS "UF_DEST", LIV.UFORIGEM AS "UF_ORIG", (SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 6) AS BASE_PIS, (SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 6) AS VLR_PIS, (SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 7) AS BASE_COFINS, (SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 7) AS VLR_COFINS, (SELECT SUM(DIN.BASE) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 2) AS BASE_ST, (SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 2) AS VLR_ST, (SELECT SUM(DIN.VLRFCPINT) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 2) AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_ST, (SELECT SUM(DIN.VLRFCPINT) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 1) AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_OP, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, PAR.IDENTINSCESTAD, CAB.CHAVENFE, (SELECT MAX(C.NUMNOTA) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS NUMNOTA_DEVOLUCAO, (SELECT MAX(I.VLRTOT) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFITE I, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRTOT_DEVOLUCAO, (SELECT MAX(I.VLRIPI) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFITE I, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRIPI_DEVOLUCAO, (SELECT MAX(I.VLRICMS) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFITE I, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRICMS_DEVOLUCAO FROM TGFCAB CAB, TGFITE ITE, TGFPRO PRO, TGFPAR PAR, TGFTOP TPO, TGFGRU GRU, TSICID CID, TSIUFS UF, TGFLIV LIV WHERE LIV.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD AND CAB.CODCIDDESTINO = CID.CODCID AND CID.UF = UF.CODUF AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER AND TPO.ATUALLIVFIS <> 'N' AND (CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND (CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI or :P_PERIODO.INI is null) AND (CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN or :P_PERIODO.FIN is null) AND (CAB.DTENTSAI >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI or :P_DTENTSAI.INI is null) AND (CAB.DTENTSAI <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN or :P_DTENTSAI.FIN is null) AND (CAB.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA OR :P_NUNOTA IS NULL) AND (CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL) AND ITE.CODCFO >= :P_CODCFOPINI AND ITE.CODCFO <= :P_CODCFOPFIN --AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' ) V GROUP BY NUNOTA, NUMNOTA, DTNEG, DTENTSAI, STATUSNFE, CODTIPOPER, CODPARC, NOMEPARC, CODTIPPARC, UF_DEST, UF_ORIG, CHAVENFE, IDENTINSCESTAD, CODCFO, CODTRIB ORDER BY DTNEG, DTENTSAI, NUMNOTA, UF_ORIG, UF_DEST
